high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for the Spartan Trail World Championship, specifically highlighting a half marathon and 50K event taking place in Liwa, Abu Dhabi. The setting is a desert landscape with sand dunes under a dramatic sky that appears to be either dawn or dusk, as indicated by the warm orange and red hues blending into darker tones. The text on the image reads: "SPARTAN TRAIL WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP" at the top, accompanied by the Spartan logo. Below it, the main text states: "HALF MARATHON AND 50K IN LIWA, ABU DHABI."
